video_title: NBA Finals Game 5 Preview: Can The Knicks End It? Are The Spurs Done?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' dominance in closeout games this season
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks are 3-0 in closeout games this year and their average margin of victory is 40 points.
quotes.quote: The Knicks are 3-0 in closeout games this year and their average margin of victory is 40 points.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Psychological challenge for Spurs and Knicks after Game 4
quotes.excerpt: I think there's a unique psychological challenge for both teams coming off that historic comeback and collapse.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Would you guys say that you felt that the Spurs were a broken team talking to them today?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: They didn't present as a broken team, but I think there's a unique psychological challenge for both teams coming off that historic comeback and collapse.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Need for a shot clock on the media table
quotes.excerpt: We've got to get a damn shot clock up here on the table. If you go past 24 seconds, you turn over the microphone.
quotes.quote: We've got to get a damn shot clock up here on the table. If you go past 24 seconds, you turn over the microphone. That got a fly that's more annoying than the freaking Knicks.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on taking the series one game at a time
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we need to isolate that one game and take it one game at a time.
quotes.quote: Yeah, everybody knows we're going to do it. But I don't know if I agree with you. I feel like we need to isolate that one game and take it one game at a time. I think it'd be a mistake to waste energy on multiple games. It's one game at a time.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' ability to close out games versus Spurs' struggles
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks have excelled in closing three of the four, and that's the difference.
quotes.quote: They've let all four games by double figures. They've had a lead in the last two minutes of all four games. They have failed to close three of the four. The Knicks have excelled in closing three of the four, and that's the difference.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' shooting performance as a factor in the series
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks have also come out in those games and shot about 9,000 percent, too.
quotes.quote: The Knicks have also come out in those games and shot about 9,000 percent, too, which is part of it. If a team comes out and makes 12 of 13 threes in the first quarter, they're probably going to win the game by a lot.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of managing Victor Wembanyama's minutes
quotes.excerpt: I think it was an inexperienced moment for Mitch Johnson where he did play Victor Wembanyama too many minutes.
quotes.quote: I think it was an inexperienced moment for Mitch Johnson where he did play Victor Wembanyama too many minutes, and that he needs to do a better job of managing the game and making sure Victor has the ability to have the energy required in the closing minutes of the game.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of Luke Kornet's performance on the series
quotes.excerpt: Luke Kornet, who was a huge off-season signing for them, has been damn near unplayable in the series.
quotes.quote: Luke Kornet, who was a huge off-season signing for them, has been damn near unplayable in the series. They're minus-19 in 31 minutes with Kornet on the court. It's not just about we need Wembanyama out there, but honestly, they've bled points when Kornet's been on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Statistical impact of Luke Kornet's minutes
quotes.excerpt: If they play Luke Kornet 10 minutes in Game 5 and they get outscored by six points.
quotes.quote: If they play Luke Kornet 10 minutes in Game 5 and they get outscored by six points, I think if you have Victor Wembanyama with energy in the fourth quarter of the game, you're going to have a hell of a lot better chance.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' strategy to attack Spurs' defense
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks used that against him a little bit by really funneling the ball to the guy he was standing near.
quotes.quote: The Knicks used that against him a little bit by really funneling the ball to the guy he was standing near to have him shoot the three. They repeatedly had Victor in rotation and were able to get shots off with him closing out.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' strategy removing Spurs' best rebounder
quotes.excerpt: That takes the Spurs' best defensive rebounder out of the picture.
quotes.quote: And you know what that does? That takes the Spurs' best defensive rebounder out of the picture.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's performance and impact on the series
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox is 28 years old, he's a vet. He's been a clutch player of the year.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox is 28 years old, he's a vet. I know he doesn't have a ton of playoff experience, but he's been a clutch player of the year. I understand riding with Fox as your primary ball-handler and decision-maker down the stretch of these games, but the simple fact of the matter is, De'Aaron Fox has only delivered in one of the four games for them.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's case for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the best player, he's scored the most points.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is the best player, he's scored the most points. I can understand why the blanket reaction is the guy who's the best player on the team will be given Finals MVP.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's growing production in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Brunson's production is growing and growing and growing, and he's on the path for Finals MVP.
quotes.quote: Brunson's production is growing and growing and growing, and he's on the path for Finals MVP. He's six of his last 12 on threes over the last two games, so his shooting is rebounding, and he's averaged 10 fourth-quarter points per game in this series.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's performance in clutch situations
quotes.excerpt: He led the league in clutch points by a wide margin.
quotes.quote: He led the league in clutch points by a wide margin. I'm not sure about fourth-quarter scoring, but clutch points.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's case for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: There's a very real chance Jalen Brunson will win MVP of the series.
quotes.quote: There's a very real chance Jalen Brunson will win MVP of the series if, let's say, the Knicks win five or six and he has an incredible game.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: David Blatt's coaching decisions with the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I have always said that David Blatt, the coach of the Cavs, did not grant him the timeout.
quotes.quote: I have always said that David Blatt, the coach of the Cavs, did not grant him the timeout that would have probably cost the Cavs that series and would have led to Chris Webber level infamy. I've always said that David Blatt owes Scott Foster a bouquet of flowers or the equivalent.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart's potential impact on the Finals MVP race
quotes.excerpt: There's a world where Josh Hart has 40 in the closeout game and suddenly there's a case for him.
quotes.quote: There's a world where Josh Hart has 40 in the closeout game and suddenly there's a case for him too. That's unlikely. It seems to be a two-horse race.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Shoutout to Art Campos at Brackenridge High School
quotes.excerpt: I want to shout out Art Campos, the head coach at Brackenridge High School in San Antonio.
quotes.quote: I want to shout out Art Campos, the head coach at Brackenridge High School in San Antonio. It is a new gym opened up in February. He's welcomed us in there. We had the pickup run there earlier in the series. We're back there tonight.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparison of Game 4 to 2013 Nets-Bulls series
quotes.excerpt: The player it reminded me of was almost the exact same thing happened in Game 4 of Nets-Bulls.
quotes.quote: The player it reminded me of was almost the exact same thing happened in Game 4 of Nets-Bulls in the first round in 2013. That was the triple overtime game where Nate Robinson had a billion points and they won in triple overtime, but it started with CJ Watson blowing that layup.
